title: The Reluctant Analyst

scopes.description: Complete author-documented workflow: prepare the I/B/E/S recommendation data, generate scale-specific analysis files, merge the other documented inputs, and perform the Bayesian estimation.

requirements.description: The entire I/B/E/S U.S. Detail recommendations extract opened as `DATA\Recommendations\Detail (entire)\c326a389b6272ec3.dta`. The supplied code uses `usfirm`, `ireccd`, `cusip`, `amaskcd`, `actdats`, `emaskcd`, `estimid`, `cname`, and `oftic`. Authors say the extract was downloaded in 2012. Scale classification scans later months across the supplied extract before the final 2003m1–2010m12 panel filter, so compatible vintage/history is not established by an in-period match alone.

I/B/E/S Detail History earnings forecasts matched to recommendation analysts using the authors’ analyst masked identifier. The exact forecast file, field mapping to the recommendation masked code, construction, and required history are not specified in the supplied code/datasheet.

routes.description: A bounded local probe read 10 rows from the catalog-listed U.S. I/B/E/S Detail History EPS file and confirmed CUSIP, ANALYS, ACTDATS, FPEDATS, VALUE, and USFIRM columns. This is a candidate forecast product; its ANALYS-to-author-masked-ID mapping, author-reported 2012 download timing, full history, and exact analysis use are unverified.
routes.expected_period: Authors report I/B/E/S data downloaded in 2012; the forecast history required for matching and analyses is not otherwise specified.

requirements.description: CRSP stock-return and trading-volume data merged to analyst recommendations by firm CUSIP, as stated in the datasheet. The necessary daily/monthly frequency, return and volume construction, event window, and full historical coverage are not specified.

routes.expected_period: Authors report CRSP data downloaded in 2012; full required period and frequency are unspecified.

routes.expected_period: Authors report CRSP data downloaded in 2012; full required period and frequency are unspecified.

issues.description: The do-file hardcodes Windows project roots and changes `main` from `[redacted-path-999ed70bad63]` to `[redacted-path-e4ede040f9c1]`, then back. The referenced data folders are not in the supplied package, so a correct accessible root and folder layout are not established.

The scale-135 stage saves `scale_135.dta` under the “The Pretty Good Analyst” root, while later joins request `scale_135.dta` under the “The Reluctant Analyst” root. No transfer or second producer is documented; the intended producer/consumer location is unresolved.

The pooled block writes `Anal_pooled_12_20.txt`, then later branches read `Anal_pooled_12_20.dta`; no producer/import step for that DTA appears in the supplied file. The pooled block drops `count` before writing the TXT, while the later DTA branch unconditionally drops `count`, so a text-to-DTA conversion alone is not a supported repair. `12_20` denotes fill-hole and minimum-observation settings, not years.

The datasheet says the prepared dependent variable and controls are fed into Bayesian estimation, but the supplied do-file ends by exporting scale-specific TXT files and contains no estimation program, manual procedure, estimation software/version, or output-to-table mapping.

actions.description: Confirm and supply the author-compatible source data and complete input contracts for the full analysis.
steps: Request the author-prepared I/B/E/S U.S. Detail recommendation extract `c326a389b6272ec3.dta`, or its documented permitted acquisition route, with the authors’ 2012 download provenance and documented full extraction/history; do not assume an exact cutoff and the fields used by the Stata file.

Request the exact I/B/E/S Detail History forecast product, required fields, and the mapping of its analyst identifier to the recommendation analyst masked code; confirm the required history and vintage.

Request the CRSP frequency/product and required period, CUSIP mapping, and return/trading-volume construction, plus the quarterly Compustat variables, CUSIP matching rules, period, and sample requirements.
Treat local `IBES.DET_EPSUS`, `CRSP.DSF`/`CRSP.MSF`, and `COMP.FUNDQ` as candidates only until full source history, vintage, fields, identifiers, and author transformations are confirmed.
validation: Verify the exact recommendation input is readable with every code-required field and the full downloaded history used for scale classification, then confirm the final 2003m1–2010m12 panel construction.
Verify the forecast, CRSP, and Compustat products against author-specified identifiers, required fields, vintages, periods, and transformations before assigning a compatible route.

actions.description: Configure the author project root and data folder only after their intended locations and the supplied data layout are confirmed.
steps: Obtain the intended root directory and expected `DATA\Recommendations\Detail (entire)` layout for a local copy of the author project.
After confirming the scale-135 handoff, configure the four `main` assignments and `cd` statements to the confirmed local root(s), preserving all relative input and output targets.
validation: Check that every `use`, `joinby`, `append`, `save`, and `outfile` resolves to the intended file under the confirmed directory layout.

actions.description: Resolve the producer and consumer location for the scale-135 intermediate before changing paths.
steps: Ask the authors whether the scale-135 producer is intentionally run under `The Pretty Good Analyst` and how its `scale_135.dta` output reaches the later `The Reluctant Analyst` consumer.
Request the intended output directory and any transfer/import step, then update path configuration only to that documented location.
validation: Confirm the producer writes the exact `scale_135.dta` path consumed by the later `joinby`, with no reliance on a stale file from another project.

actions.description: Obtain the missing pooled-DTA producer and its schema before relying on the downstream scale branches.
steps: Ask the authors for the producer/import step for `Anal_pooled_12_20.dta`, including its order relative to the TXT export and whether it belongs to a separate companion program.
Request the exact field contract for that DTA, including why the later branches expect `count` when the visible pooled block drops it before exporting TXT.
Do not substitute a TXT-to-DTA conversion or add a save command until the authors confirm the required schema and producer.
validation: Confirm the documented producer creates the exact DTA path with all fields expected by both downstream consumers before either branch runs.

actions.description: Obtain the missing Bayesian estimation workflow and its input/output contract.
steps: Request the author estimation program(s) or documented manual procedure, required software and version, model configuration/resources, and the input fields/layout expected from the scale-specific TXT outputs.
Request a mapping from each three-tier and five-tier branch to the reported analysis tables and any model output files.
validation: Confirm that all reported estimates in scope are mapped to an author-supplied estimation entry point or complete manual procedure and its required software and inputs.

review_notes: No analysis_only scope is supported: the supplied code starts from raw I/B/E/S recommendations, no author-prepared analysis dataset is included, and the downstream Bayesian estimation workflow is absent.

Bounded probes confirm local readability of candidate I/B/E/S Detail History EPS, CRSP daily and monthly stock, and Compustat quarterly products. These probes read 10 rows and do not establish full history, required sample coverage, the authors’ the authors’ 2012 download timing, or unreported field mappings.

The scale-classification loops use later observations across the full supplied recommendation extract before the final 2003m1–2010m12 restriction. The suffix `12_20` denotes fill-hole/minimum-observation settings, not years.
The Stata `anyvalue()` calls were checked through their `_ganyvalue` function entry point; Stata 18 and that function are locally available. No author code or regression was run.
